focus: oval reset, e vs l, review r s

fix.e: Last time yours were tall and narrow, which reads as l.

fix.r: Last time the shoulder got overdrawn and later r's turned into H or M shapes: keep it small.
fix.s: Keep the base the same on every s (some turned into 5 or A shapes).

review.note: No model. Ovals again at the end of the session, to see whether the coil comes back when you are tired.

tip: e and l both have a loop; height is what separates them. A coil that creeps right is usually finger-driven writing: count aloud and move the forearm.
